TECHNICAL_BANKING_FAILURE.description: Network timeout or bank UPI downtime. Schedule automated retry in 4-6 hours with zero merchant discount.

INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS_TIMING.description: Insufficient balance near month end. Align retry window with 1st-5th salary cycle + friendly WhatsApp nudge.

SILENT_CHURN_DISENGAGEMENT.description: Member attendance dropped >70% in last 3 weeks. Offer personal trainer check-in + 10% loyalty retention credit.

CARD_MANDATE_EXPIRED.description: Recurring mandate token invalidated. Generate dynamic Razorpay Payment Link for instant authorization.

AFFORDABILITY_PRICE_SENSITIVE.description: Explicit price friction. Offer maximum allowed 15% discount or quarterly tier downgrade.

HIGH_VALUE_VIP_RISK.description: Annual corporate or VIP plan > ₹50,000. Escalate directly to Gym General Manager.
